_info: Tutorial in the first battle (decision 30.10.2026). Steps follow one another; a step ends when the player does what it describes (done): selected (a hero selected), order_point (order to a place), running (battle running), order_group (order at an enemy group), ability (ability used), hold (H), ok (only the Got it button). What the player did earlier counts. trigger = the step shows when the situation arises (contact: an awake enemy within 10 m of a hero or a group woke up; combat: a hero is fighting; warn: a commander is preparing an ability); then the battle pauses itself so the player can react. Until then the panel shows wait_text. anchor = what the card is pinned to with an arrow: heroes, ahead (the spot in front of the heroes), pause (the button at the top), foe (the nearest awake enemy), cards (the ability button), warn (the commander's announced circle).
title: Tutorial

steps.text: Select a hero: left-click him, or left-drag a box over several heroes. Ctrl+A selects the whole squad.
Send the selected heroes: right-click the ground, for example here. The circle under the cursor shows what will happen (white = go here, blue = stay with an ally, red = attack a group).
The battle is paused now. Start it with Space (or the button at the top). Space pauses it again at any time so you can give orders calmly.

steps.wait_text: The battle is running. Watch the enemy: once they start moving, the game will pause and advise you.
steps.text: Enemies are coming at you, the game has paused. Select the squad (Ctrl+A) and right-click an enemy: the heroes will go after its whole group. Then resume with Space.

steps.wait_text: The heroes are heading into the fight. When they clash, the game will pause.
steps.text: The fight has begun, the game has paused. Use an ability: press the key in the box on a hero's card (1–5), then aim a targeted one with the right button. Each has 3 uses per battle and recharges. Then resume with Space.
The H key cancels the selected heroes' orders: they stop and defend themselves. That is how you stop a hero who runs too far. Try it.

steps.wait_text: Good. One more thing: when an enemy commander starts preparing an ability, the game will pause.
steps.text: A commander is preparing an ability: the red circle shows where it will land. Get out of it (right-click outside) or stun the commander with Charge. Then resume with Space.
